factoryName.metadata: Nombre de instancia de Data Factory

scriptLines: payment_date = case(regexMatch(trim(payment_date),'^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$'), toDate(trim(payment_date),'yyyy-MM-dd'), regexMatch(trim(payment_date),'^\\d{2}/\\d{2}/\\d{4}$'), toDate(trim(payment_date),'MM/dd/yyyy'), regexMatch(trim(payment_date),'^\\d{2}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$'), toDate(trim(payment_date),'MM-dd-yy'), regexMatch(trim(payment_date),'^\\d{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-\\d{4}$'), toDate(trim(payment_date),'dd-MMM-yyyy'), toDate(trim(payment_date),'MMMM dd, yyyy'))) ~> limpiar
limpiar1 derive(icd_code = iif(instr(icd_code,'.')==0 && length(icd_code)>3, concat(left(icd_code,3),'.',substring(icd_code,4)), icd_code)) ~> limpiar2
limpiar derive(date_of_birth = iif(date_of_birth > currentDate(), addMonths(date_of_birth,-1200), date_of_birth)) ~> corregirsiglo
